mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.0%, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces corporate profit expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of months when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 295) and elevated policy rates (FEDFUNDS > 3.5%) compress real equity valuations through higher discount rates and reduced corporate margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 295 and FEDFUNDS > 3.5.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic expansions, a decline in housing starts (HOUST < 1500) combined with weak retail sales (RSAFS < 650000) signals a contraction in consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 40% of late-cycle expansion periods when HOUST < 1500 and RSAFS < 650000.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates strengthening manufacturing activity, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when INDPRO increases by at least 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1500 thousand units, it signals a contraction in the housing market that reduces consumer wealth and spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of months when HOUST < 1500.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, a federal funds rate above 4.0% compresses corporate debt financing and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of months during monetary tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS > 4.0.

mechanism_narrative: A GDP level below 19800 billion dollars (indicating economic contraction) combined with declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals a slowing economy, reducing corporate profit growth and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when GDPC1 < 19800 and INDPRO < 100.
